question: Should `openclawProgressKind: "tool-progress"` and its predicate become a supported public Plugin SDK contract for generic progress-producing plugins?
rationale: The fix needs a cross-plugin seam because bundled Codex cannot import Slack internals, but publishing the marker creates a durable third-party API that automation should not accept implicitly.

options.title: Accept the generic typed contract
options.body: Keep the additive generic marker and predicate, then repair native-block propagation and document its progress-only semantics.

options.title: Keep the contract internal
options.body: Redesign the cross-boundary signal so bundled code can use it without exposing a new third-party Plugin SDK API.

recommendation.title: Accept the generic typed contract
recommendation.body: Keep the additive generic marker and predicate, then repair native-block propagation and document its progress-only semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged history spans the Codex harness, Slack reply delivery, and Plugin SDK boundary design involved in this API choice.
